subtitulo: This is the page your clients see. Pick a template, edit your text and publish.
nuncaPublicado: You haven't published any changes yet
salirSinGuardar: You have unpublished changes. If you leave now they're lost.
qrAlt: QR code for the barbershop page
compartirAyuda: Paste this link in your Instagram bio, on Google and in your WhatsApp. The QR is for the door or the mirror.
plantillaAyuda: Switching templates keeps your text, your photos and your reviews.
acentoAyuda: Colors stay inside the brand palette so your page always looks right.
seccionesAyuda: Turn on, turn off and reorder what your client sees. The ones you can't move are the ones holding the page together.
seccionSinDatos: There are no {que} yet, so this section doesn't show on your page.
galeriaAyuda: Your best work. They're compressed before uploading, so your phone camera is fine.
galeriaVacia: You haven't uploaded any photos yet.
resenasAyuda: Write down what your clients tell you. It shows on your page exactly as you type it.
horarioAyuda: Front-door hours: when you open and when you close. It's what shows on your page and what Google reads.
contactoWhatsappAyuda: 10 digits with area code. It's the number your clients message from the page.
contactoMapaAyuda: Optional. Leave it blank and we build the map from your barbershop address.
seoAyuda: Leave it blank and we build it from your barbershop name and city.
seoImagenAyuda: It's the photo that shows when someone sends your link over WhatsApp.
publicacionVisible: Your page is published and anyone can see it.
publicacionOculta: Your page is off. Anyone visiting sees a "coming soon" notice.
vistaAyuda: This is how it looks right now, with what you've typed.
vistaFalloCuerpo: What you've typed is NOT lost: it's still here and you can publish it. Undo your last change to bring the preview back.
sinPermisoTitulo: You don't have permission to edit the page
sinPermisoCuerpo: Ask the barbershop owner to give you the "Edit the mini-site" permission.
sinTablaCuerpo: The mini-site table doesn't exist yet. sql/barber_complemento.sql has to be applied in Supabase before you can save.
upsellCuerpo: On the Básico plan your barbershop has a website with the Clásica template, your services, your barbers and your booking button. To pick from all 8 templates, change the text, upload your photos and publish whenever you want, move up to Avanzado.
